conventions.name: Review in code-review (opt-in)
conventions.description: Only when the user asks for a task to be reviewed in code-review: open a review on the worker's checkout naming the worker as author, relay its rounds to the worker, have reviewer lenses post findings into it, hold the merge on its blockers.

tools.name: open_review
tools.description: Open, or reuse, a review of one checkout. range = base...HEAD (base defaults to the checkout's fork point), commit = one commit (sha defaults to HEAD), uncommitted = working tree vs HEAD. Range and commit read committed history only. Checkout: `project`+`worktree` (omit `worktree` for the main checkout), else yours; a conductor must name `project`. You receive the human's submitted rounds.

worktree.description: Worktree name; omit for the main checkout.

base.description: Range base: a branch or sha.

author.description: Conductor only, range or commit: the worker session whose commits these are; it takes the author role.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Rollup: target, round, per-file hunk verdicts and thread counts, mergeBlockers, the round's groups and its ungrouped hunks.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: Threads with their anchored lines and messages; cited code is inlined. A thread can also sit on a whole file, a group, or the review itself.

owner.description: Only threads the user, or an agent, opened.

tools.name: get_hunk
tools.description: Diff text with line numbers, verdict and groups: one hunk by `hunk` id or by `file`+new-side `line`, or every hunk of `file`.

tools.name: annotate
tools.description: Start a thread on lines, a hunk, a whole file, a group, or the review (`anchor`). A finding needs `severity`. Cite code as path#L10-L20.

anchor.description: What the thread is on: `lines` (file+startLine[+endLine, side]), `hunk` (hunk), `file` (file: the whole file), `group` (group), `review` (the review itself; no file, lines or hunk).

file.description: File path, relative to the checkout root.

side.description: Which side of the diff the lines are on (default new); lines anchors only.

endLine.description: Last line, defaulting to startLine; lines anchors only.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply on a thread. resolve:true closes an open thread you opened (a conductor: any open thread an agent opened); a finding also needs `disposition`. Otherwise it proposes resolution to the human. The returned thread's `resolveProposed` says which.

resolve.description: Close or propose closing the thread.

disposition.description: With resolve:true on a finding you may close.

tools.name: propose_groups
tools.description: Set the current round's groups: ordered review steps, each a set of hunks (across files if needed) with a title and a markdown description of what they accomplish together. Replaces the round's groups; a group with exactly the hunks of an existing one keeps its verdict and threads. A hunk may sit in several groups; hunks in none show as other changes.

groups.description: Every group, in reading order. title: one line; description: markdown; hunks: this round's hunk ids (without h:), at least one.

tools.name: refresh_review
tools.description: Re-snapshot after committing fixes. Unchanged hunks keep their verdicts and changed ones reset to pending. Threads follow their lines or go outdated. Groups whose hunks all survive carry over; others are dropped. Not for commit reviews.
